arguments.query: SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name

SELECT 'booking' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'hold',h.booking_id) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status<>'confirmed'
UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'booking_id',c.booking_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status<>'confirmed'
UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status<>'delivered'
UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache
UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)) FROM flights f

SELECT 'customer_event' AS kind,json_object('event_id',e.event_id,'request_id',e.request_id,'kind',e.kind,'step',e.step,'booking_id',b.booking_id) AS data FROM customer_events e LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(request_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'booking_id',c.booking_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'log',json_object('id',id,'service',service,'trace_id',trace_id,'status',status,'message',message) FROM request_logs WHERE trace_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM bookings WHERE status='pending') OR message LIKE '%bkg_5e5e7ba188f453c29d83f97918554e26%' OR message LIKE '%bkg_3d21a82501d357539abc9ea79a0cb5c7%' OR message LIKE '%bkg_91887b609e4b50e9afa3aefdcd74f0c1%' OR message LIKE '%bkg_47273ce4681e53868e8c7b789bd03339%'
UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'customer_event' AS kind,json_object('event_id',e.event_id,'request_id',e.request_id,'kind',e.kind,'step',e.step,'booking_id',b.booking_id) AS data FROM customer_events e LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(request_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'log',json_object('id',id,'service',service,'path',path,'status',status,'trace_id',trace_id,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs ORDER BY id LIMIT 50)
UNION ALL SELECT 'pending',json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'client_reference',client_reference) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending'

SELECT 'counts' AS kind,json_object(
'confirmed_missing_hold',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id)),
'confirmed_charge_count_wrong',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')<>1),
'confirmed_missing_checkin',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)),
'confirmed_missing_event',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')),
'oversold',(SELECT count(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity),
'duplicates',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1)),
'cancelled_backed',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)))) AS data
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'cancel_event',e.event_id,'refund_cents',(SELECT sum(amount_cents) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) WHERE b.status='cancelled'
UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',json_object('charge_id',charge_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'state',state,'amount',amount_cents) FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN ('bkg_47273ce4681e53868e8c7b789bd03339','bkg_6460bb3febdb554b8612b341bdd6bd01','bkg_6f683d34bf5d5a90a62eb16d52046368','bkg_3d21a82501d357539abc9ea79a0cb5c7','bkg_91887b609e4b50e9afa3aefdcd74f0c1')
UNION ALL SELECT 'log',json_object('id',id,'service',service,'status',status,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE status>=400 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12)

SELECT 'customer_event' AS kind,json_object('event_id',e.event_id,'booking_id',b.booking_id,'status',b.status,'step',e.step) AS data FROM customer_events e LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(request_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_charge',json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'booking_id',c.booking_id,'state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents,'booking_amount',b.amount_cents) FROM charges c LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR c.amount_cents<>b.amount_cents
UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_hold',json_object('booking_id',h.booking_id,'flight',h.flight_id,'passenger',h.passenger_id,'status',b.status) FROM holds h LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status<>'confirmed' OR b.flight_id<>h.flight_id OR b.passenger_id<>h.passenger_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_checkin',json_object('booking_id',c.booking_id,'flight',c.flight_id,'passenger',c.passenger_id,'status',b.status) FROM checkins c LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status<>'confirmed' OR b.flight_id<>c.flight_id OR b.passenger_id<>c.passenger_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'bad_event',json_object('event_id',o.event_id,'booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'status',o.status) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status<>'confirmed' OR b.booking_id<>json_extract(o.payload,'$.booking_id') OR b.flight_id<>json_extract(o.payload,'$.flight_id') OR b.passenger_id<>json_extract(o.payload,'$.passenger_id') OR o.status<>'delivered'
UNION ALL SELECT 'refund',json_object('refund_id',r.refund_id,'charge_id',r.charge_id,'booking_id',r.booking_id,'refund_amount',r.amount_cents,'charge_amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'booking_status',b.status) FROM refunds r LEFT JOIN charges c USING(charge_id) LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=r.booking_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_charges_all_states',json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'count',count(*),'states',group_concat(state)) FROM charges GROUP BY booking_id HAVING count(*)>1
UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights
UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config
